import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 赠送礼物指令
 * /赠送                      → 显示我的好友
 * /赠送 <uid|@目标>          → 显示礼物列表供挑选
 * /赠送 <礼物名称>           → 显示我的好友供挑选
 * /赠送 <uid|@目标> <礼物名称> → 直接赠送
 */
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { commandBackendCompanionGift } from '@src/api/bot/companion-gift-command';
import { canAccessFifthLayerFeature, sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const fifthLayerAccess = await canAccessFifthLayerFeature(uid, bid);

  if (!fifthLayerAccess.ok) {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '赠送礼物', realmName: fifthLayerAccess.realmName });

    return;
  }

  const text = e.MessageText?.trim() ?? '';
  const match = text.match(/^[!！/#＃]?赠送(?:\s+(\S+))?(?:\s+(.+))?\s*$/);

  if (!match) {
    return;
  }

  const firstParam = match[1]?.trim();
  const secondParam = match[2]?.trim();
  const mentioned = await mention.findOne();
  const command = await commandBackendCompanionGift(
    bid,
    uid,
    {
      firstParam,
      secondParam,
      targetBid: mentioned?.count && mentioned.data?.UserId ? mentioned.data.UserId : undefined
    },
    createBackendRequestContext(e),
    e.MessageText
  );
  const firstParamUid = command.targetId;
  const isFirstParamUid = command.mode === 'OPTIONS';

  // ── 场景4: 两个参数 → 直接赠送 ──
  if (firstParam && secondParam) {
    const targetUid = command.targetId;
    const giftName = command.giftName;

    if (!targetUid || !giftName) {
      const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      errMd.addText('格式错误，请使用：/赠送 <UID|@目标> <礼物名称>');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赠送礼物', content: errMd }));

      return;
    }

    const result =
      command.mutationError || !command.mutation
        ? { code: 'GIFT_FAIL' as const, data: { message: command.mutationError ?? '赠送失败，请稍后再试' } }
        : { code: 'GIFT_OK' as const, data: command.mutation };

    if (result.code === 'GIFT_OK') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      if (result.data.tongxinGained && result.data.tongxinGained > 0) {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`同心值 +${result.data.tongxinGained}`);
      }

      md.addNewline();
      md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown([result.data.reply]));

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赠送礼物', content: md }));
    } else {
      const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();
      const repeatMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, createBackendRequestContext(e));

      errMd.addText(repeatMsg);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赠送礼物', content: errMd }));
    }

    return;
  }

  // ── 场景2: 只有uid → 显示礼物列表 ──
  if (firstParam && isFirstParamUid) {
    const targetUid = firstParamUid;

    if (!targetUid) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (command.queryError) {
        throw new Error(command.queryError);
      }
      const giftListResult = command.options!;

      if (!giftListResult.targetFound) {
        const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

        errMd.addText('未找到该用户');

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赠送礼物', content: errMd }));

        return;
      }

      const d = giftListResult;
      const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`赠送给：${d.targetName ?? d.targetId}`));

      if (d.gifts.length === 0) {
        contentMd.addText('── 可赠送的礼物 ──');
        contentMd.addNewline();
        contentMd.addText('储物袋中没有礼物');
        contentMd.addNewline();
        contentMd.addText('💡 可在万宝楼购买礼物');
      } else {
        for (const gift of d.gifts) {
          let limitText: string;

          if (gift.isPremium) {
            const dailyRemaining = d.dailyPremiumGiftLimit - d.dailyPremiumGiftUsed;

            limitText = dailyRemaining > 0 ? `今日:${dailyRemaining}/${d.dailyPremiumGiftLimit}` : '今日已达上限';
          } else {
            limitText = d.weeklyIntimacyUsed < d.weeklyIntimacyLimit ? `周灵契:${d.weeklyIntimacyUsed}/${d.weeklyIntimacyLimit}` : '周灵契已达上限';
          }

          contentMd.addBlockquote(
            createQuoteMarkdown(
              [gift.name, `${limitText} 数量:${gift.quantity}`, `灵契+${gift.intimacy}`],
              [{ label: '赠送', command: `/赠送 ${d.targetId} ${gift.name}` }]
            )
          );
        }
      }

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '赠送礼物',
          header: [
            { label: '返回', command: '/赠送' },
            { label: '万宝楼', command: '/商店 万宝楼' },
            { label: '记录', command: '/赠礼记录' }
          ],
          content: contentMd
        })
      );
    } catch (_error) {
      logger.error('赠送礼物列表加载失败:', _error);
      const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      errMd.addText('❌ 加载失败，请稍后重试');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赠送礼物', content: errMd }));
    }

    return;
  }

  // ── 场景3: 只有礼物名 → 显示我的好友 ──
  if (firstParam && !isFirstParamUid) {
    const giftName = firstParam;

    if (command.queryError) {
      throw new Error(command.queryError);
    }
    const friendResult = command.targets!;

    if (!friendResult.giftExists) {
      const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      errMd.addText(`未找到礼物「${giftName}」`);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赠送礼物', content: errMd }));

      return;
    }

    try {
      if (friendResult.friends.length === 0) {
        const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

        contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('暂无好友可赠送礼物'));

        void message.send(
          FormatGui({
            isPrivate,
            bid,
            title: `赠送「${giftName}」`,
            content: contentMd
          })
        );

        return;
      }

      const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`选择要赠送「${giftName}」的好友`));

      for (const friend of friendResult.friends) {
        const relationText = friend.isCompanion ? '【道侣】' : '';

        contentMd.addBlockquote(
          createQuoteMarkdown([`${relationText}${friend.friendName}`], [{ label: '赠送', command: `/赠送 ${friend.friendId} ${giftName}` }])
        );
      }

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: `赠送「${giftName}」`,
          header: [
            { label: '返回', command: '/赠送' },
            { label: '记录', command: '/赠礼记录' }
          ],
          content: contentMd
        })
      );
    } catch (_error) {
      logger.error('我的好友加载失败:', _error);
      const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      errMd.addText('❌ 加载失败，请稍后重试');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赠送礼物', content: errMd }));
    }

    return;
  }

  // ── 场景1: 无参数 → 显示我的好友 ──
  try {
    if (command.queryError) {
      throw new Error(command.queryError);
    }
    const friendResult = command.targets!;

    if (friendResult.friends.length === 0) {
      const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

      contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('暂无好友可赠送礼物'));
      contentMd.addText('💡 先添加好友后再来赠送吧');

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '赠送礼物',
          header: [
            { label: '返回', command: '/我的好友' },
            { label: '记录', command: '/赠礼记录' }
          ],
          content: contentMd
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('选择要赠送的好友'));

    for (const friend of friendResult.friends) {
      const relationText = friend.isCompanion ? '【道侣】' : '';

      contentMd.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown([`${relationText}${friend.friendName}`], [{ label: '选择', command: `/赠送 ${friend.friendId}` }]));
    }

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '赠送礼物 - 选择好友',
        header: [
          { label: '返回', command: '/我的好友' },
          { label: '记录', command: '/赠礼记录' }
        ],
        content: contentMd
      })
    );
  } catch (_error) {
    logger.error('我的好友加载失败:', _error);
    const errMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    errMd.addText('❌ 加载失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '赠送礼物', content: errMd }));
  }
});
